notes: Follow-up of our 1 Oct pool story (TechCrunch, 30 Sep). Read PPC Land.
headline: Reddit will end public access to its Data API in March 2027 and stop its RSS feeds on 13 Nov 2026.
score_reason: Pool score 5 kept: the plan was announced 30 Sep 2026, but today's report adds the registration count and the migration terms.
importance_line: Moderators, researchers, news-reader users and AI assistants that read Reddit for free must move to Reddit's developer platform or sign agreements, though Reddit and TechCrunch word the 12 Jan 2027 cut-off for unregistered apps differently.
summary: PPC Land reports, citing TechCrunch and Reddit's own posts of 30 Sep 2026, that Reddit will stop RSS feeds on 13 Nov 2026 and close remaining public Data API access in March 2027, moving bots and tools to its Devvit Developer Platform. New today: Reddit says more than 14,000 apps and bots have registered, and it offers $1,000 per app that migrates by 30 Nov 2026.
